visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. competitiveTarget: Beat generic buyer-intent pages: live MLS search as the next step, a specific process walkthrough, buyer strategy sub-pages, and a listing-alerts ask. Zero invented stats. Above the fold at 1440x900 the page answers 'what is the market doing' with sourced figures and shows a real listing, which is where the portal search pages are beaten: they show inventory but no trace, no as-of date, and no broker.

Three scorings of one capture from the production build, median. Separate from the builder.

shotSpec.capture: first viewport, scripts/take-route-shots.mjs default, scale 1, palette-quantized, against the production build (next start) on http://127.0.0.1:3402

tasteReview.beats: Zillow's Bend buy/search landing — this page wins on honest, sourced plain-language stats ('$749,500 half the houses ask more', cited to Live MLS with a calc-method disclosure), but Zillow's map-driven results view still beats it on interactivity: nothing in the fold scrubs, filters, or expands.

defects.section: Homes in Bend and nearby (4-card row)
defects.finding: Four listings render as identical fixed-width cards in a static row with no rail affordance, no scroll cue and no size variation in the first viewport; the layout lock calls for a field of live homes, not a wall of identical cards. The carousel's prev/next sit UNDER the rail (HomeListingRail's .home-rail__arrows, static), below the 900px fold — so no carousel object is visible in the shot.

defects.section: hero stat band under 'Buy a home in Central Oregon'
defects.finding: The three market figures (inventory, median ask, days to an offer) read as flat text with a static source line — the doors are real links but nothing in the still signals hover or scrub, so the live-market promise reads as copy rather than an instrument.

On mobile the second card is sliced mid-photo at the viewport edge with no partial-card affordance or arrow in frame (the arrows are below the fold), so it reads as a layout break rather than an intentional horizontal scroll.

tasteReview.verdict: Competent, on-brand Stage-then-shelves open — navy/cream/Amboqia held, real sourced numbers, no invented figures, and for the first time a priced house (ask, address, beds/baths/sqft) is in the 1440 fold — but demoMatch is FALSE: the carousel chrome is parked under the rail, out of the first viewport, so a static grid stands in for the inventory rail, and the stat band is inert text. The same flanking-chevron fix V3Carousel received in 7b5535bd is what HomeListingRail needs; its file is held by another surface's unpushed work this round. Not Tip Ready; node stays in_progress.
